edge_semantics.failure_mode_exposure: Derived: a component is exposed to a failure mode when its atlas row cites an axiom the failure mode violates; not a check and not an observed incident.
edge_semantics.grounded_in_doctrine: The component's atlas row lists this rule, concept, mechanism or paper module; an authored citation, not a check that the component enforces it.
edge_semantics.has_formal_subclaim: A narrower modeled algorithm contract; never whole-component verification.
edge_semantics.has_replay_configuration: Declared runner/input/output configuration; no execution, freshness or domain correctness claim.
edge_semantics.has_retained_formal_proof: Named retained Dafny contract with current source/generated hash binding; no fresh prover run.
edge_semantics.proven_by: Legacy compatibility: historical bounded authority receipt; never a domain theorem or fresh proof result.
edge_semantics.rests_on: Authored principle cites an axiom as its basis; not a formal implication.
edge_semantics.routes_to: a task-class entry point whose fan-out includes the organ; navigation, not execution order
edge_semantics.violates: Authored anti-principle identifies an axiom it violates; not an observed incident.
